mil5.3.4:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, bhāsitam-p' etaṃ therena Sāriputtena Dhammasenāpatinā: Parisuddhavacīsamācāro āvuso Tathāgato, na-tthi Tathāgatassa vacīduccaritaṃ yaṃ Tathāgato rakkheyya: mā me idaṃ paro aññāsīti.
mil5.3.4:1.2: Puna ca Tathāgato therassa Sudinnassa Kalandaputtassa aparādhe pārājikaṃ paññāpento pharusāhi vācāhi moghapurisavādena samudācari, tena ca so thero moghapurisavādena garuttāsena tāsito vippaṭisārī nāsakkhi ariyamaggaṃ paṭivijihituṃ.
mil5.3.4:1.3: Yadi bhante Nāgasena parisuddhavacīsamācaro Tathāgatho, na-tthi Tathāgatassa vacīduccaritaṃ, tena hi: Tathāgatena therassa Sudinnassa Kalandaputtassa aparādhe moghapurisavādena samudāciṇṇan-ti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.3.4:1.4: Yadi Bhagavatā therassa Sudinnassa Kalandaputtassa aparādhe moghapurisavādena samudāciṇṇaṃ, tena hi: parisuddhavacīsamācāro Tathāgato, na-tthi Tathāgatassa vacīduccaritan-ti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā.
mil5.3.4:1.5: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.3.4:2.1: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena Dhammasenāpatinā:
mil5.3.4:2.2: Parisuddhavacīsamācāro āvuso Tathāgato, na-tthi Tathāgatassa vacīduccaritaṃ yaṃ Tathāgato rakkheyya: mā me idaṃ paro aññāsīti.
mil5.3.4:2.3: Āyasmato ca Sudinnassa Kalandaputtassa aparādhe pārājikaṃ paññāpentena Bhagavatā moghapurisavādena samudāciṇṇaṃ. Tañ-ca pana na duṭṭhacittena, asārambhena yāthāvalakkhaṇena.
mil5.3.4:2.4: Kiñ-ca tattha yāthāvalakkhaṇaṃ. Yassa mahārāja puggalassa imasmiṃ attabhāve catusaccābhisamayo na hoti, tassa purisattanaṃ moghaṃ, aññaṃ kayiramānaṃ aññena sambhavati, tena vuccati moghapuriso ti.
mil5.3.4:2.5: Iti pi mahārāja Bhagavatā āyasmato Sudinnassa Kalandaputtassa sabhāvavacanena samudāciṇṇaṃ, no abhūtavādenāti.-Sabhāvam-
mil5.3.4:3.1: pi bhante Nāgasena yo akkosanto bhaṇati, tassa mayaṃ kahāpaṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dhārema, aparādho yeva so, vatthuṃ nissāya visuṃ vohāraṃ ācaranto akkosatīti. -
mil5.3.4:3.2: Atthi pana mahārāja sutapubbaṃ tayā khalitassa abhivādanaṃ vā paccuṭṭhānaṃ vā sakkāraṃ vā upāyanānuppadānaṃ vā ti. -
mil5.3.4:3.3: Na hi bhante, yato kutoci yattha katthaci khalito paribhāsanāraho hoti tajjanāraho, uttamangam-pi 'ssa chindanti, hananti pi bandhanti pi ghātenti pi jāpenti pīti. -
mil5.3.4:3.4: Tena hi mahārāja Bhagavatā kiriyā yeva katā no akiriyā ti.
mil5.3.4:4.1: Kiriyam-pi bhante Nāgasena kurumānena patirūpena kātabbaṃ anucchavikena, savanena pi bhante Nāgasena Tathāgatassa sadevako loko ottapati hiriyati, bhiyyo dassanena, tat' uttariṃ upasankamanena payirupāsanenāti. -
mil5.3.4:4.2: Api nu kho mahārāja tikicchako abhisanne kāye kupite dose sinehaniyāni bhesajjāni detīti. -
mil5.3.4:4.3: Na hi bhante, tiṇhāni lekhaniyāni bhesajjāni arogakāmo detīti.-Evameva
mil5.3.4:4.4: kho mahārāja Tathāgato sabbakilesabyādhivūpasamanāya anusatthiṃ deti. Pharusā pi mahārāja Tathāgatassa vācā satte sinehayati, muduke karoti.
mil5.3.4:4.5: Yathā mahārāja uṇham-pi udakaṃ yaṃ kiñci sinehaniyaṃ sinehayati, muduṃ karoti,
mil5.3.4:4.6: evam-eva kho mahārāja pharusā pi Tathāgatassa vācā atthavatī hoti karuṇāsahagatā.
mil5.3.4:4.7: Yathā mahārāja pitu vacanaṃ puttānaṃ atthavantaṃ hoti karuṇāsahagataṃ,
mil5.3.4:4.8: evam-eva kho mahārāja pharusā pi Tathāgatassa vācā atthavatī hoti karuṇāsahagatā.
mil5.3.4:4.9: Pharusā pi mahārāja Tathāgatassa vācā sattānaṃ kilesappahānā hoti.
mil5.3.4:4.10: Yathā mahārāja duggandham-pi gomuttaṃ pītaṃ, virasam-pi agadaṃ khāyitaṃ sattānaṃ byādhiṃ hanti,
mil5.3.4:4.11: evam-eva kho mahārāja pharusā pi Tathāgatassa vācā atthavatī hoti karuṇāsahagatā.
mil5.3.4:4.12: Yathā mahārāja mahanto pi tūlapuñjo parassa kāye nipatitvā rujaṃ na karoti,
mil5.3.4:4.13: evam-eva kho mahārāja pharusā pi Tathāgatassa vācā na kassaci dukkhaṃ uppādetīti. -
mil5.3.4:4.14: Suvinicchito bhante Nāgasena pañho bahūhi kāraṇehi,
mil5.3.4:4.15: sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
